Q0159

“One who knows others is wise; one who knows oneself is enlightened.…” — Laozi (Q0159)

An English quotation associated with Daodejing, Ch. 33, organized here under knowledge.

Quotes / Laozi / Q0159

English

One who knows others is wise; one who knows oneself is enlightened. One who conquers others has strength; one who conquers oneself is truly strong. One who knows contentment is rich; one who persists has will.
Thinker Laozi
School Daoism
Source Daodejing, Ch. 33
Theme Knowledge
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Daodejing, Ch. 33, within the Daoism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of knowledge, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Laozi's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
